run_conversational_chatbot: run a Groq-based conversational chatbot using the llama3-70b-8192 model in an interactive console loop
create_groq_client: create a Groq client initialized with the GROQ_API_KEY environment variable
build_chat_history: build a chat history list that tracks user and assistant messages with a system prompt
refactor_system_prompt: refactor the system prompt to change the assistant's behavior and response style
review_chat_completion: review the chat.completions.create call to adjust model, max_tokens, or temperature parameters
